title: AI Script Registry
description: Schema for docs/ai/script-registry.json. Each registered script declares its identity, risk class, approval surface, dry-run support, and verification expectations.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the registry contract.

scripts.description: Script entries keyed by stable script id.

id.description: Stable identifier used by routers and policies.

path.description: Legacy repo-relative script path. Prefer installed_path.

risk.description: Mutation class controlling the approval boundary. Severity lives in 'tier'.

tier.description: Optional risk-severity tier. Absent on simple tier-0 wrappers.

autonomy_level.description: Maximum default autonomy level for the script. See docs/ai/capabilities/authorization-and-tool-governance/CAPABILITY.md.

profiles.description: Derived permission profiles that may see/run the script.

required_tools.description: Tools the script always needs to launch safely.

optional_tools.description: Tools only some modes need; missing ones degrade with warnings, not failure.

writes_paths.description: Repo-relative or declared evidence/generated paths the script may write.

introspection.description: Static introspection contract for the script.

evidence.description: Where structured evidence is written when the script runs.
